policies.title_zh: 仿制药质量和疗效一致性评价 (GCE)
policies.title_en: Generic Drug Quality and Efficacy Consistency Evaluation (GCE)
policies.summary_zh: 国办发〔2016〕8号要求仿制药对标原研重新验证质量与疗效，通过评价成为参与国家集采的门槛，倒逼仿制药行业大规模整合与质量升级。
policies.summary_en: State Council Circular [2016] No. 8 mandated generic drugs to re-demonstrate quality and efficacy equivalence to originators; passing the evaluation became a prerequisite for national volume-based procurement, forcing large-scale consolidation and quality upgrading across China's generic drug industry.
policies.agency_zh: 国务院办公厅 / 国家药品监督管理局 (NMPA)
policies.agency_en: General Office of the State Council / National Medical Products Administration (NMPA)

detail.direction_zh: 通过强制性再评价，将已上市仿制药质量拉齐至与原研药'质量和疗效一致'的标准，并以'过评'作为集采入场券，以市场竞争机制淘汰低质产品、推动行业集中度提升。
detail.direction_en: Force re-evaluation of marketed generics to achieve quality and efficacy equivalence with originators; use passing evaluation as the market-entry ticket for national volume-based procurement to eliminate substandard products and raise industry concentration.
detail.focus_zh: 化学药仿制药（口服固体制剂优先，后扩展至注射剂及其他剂型）质量再验证；参比制剂选择、生物等效性/临床试验、技术审评、研制现场核查
detail.focus_en: Quality re-verification of chemical generic drugs (oral solid dosage forms prioritized, later extended to injections and other dosage forms); reference formulation selection, BE/clinical trials, technical review, on-site inspection
detail.implications_zh: 一致性评价与集采联动，直接重塑仿制药行业格局：过评品种获优先采购和医保支持，未过评品种逐步丧失市场准入；3家及以上企业过评后同品种未过评产品不再被采购，加速市场出清；头部企业凭借研发实力批量过评、占据集采份额，中小企业大量退出；同时倒逼企业加大创新研发投入，加速转型。截至2024年底，累计过评（含视同过评）品种数达2,998个，委托生产占比从2020年的12%升至2024年的33%，产业链整合态势明显。
detail.implications_en: GCE is tightly coupled with VBP, directly reshaping the generic landscape: products passing evaluation gain preferred procurement and reimbursement support; once 3+ companies pass for the same molecule, non-compliant products are excluded from procurement; leading companies leverage R&D strength to pass in bulk and capture VBP share, while small/mid-sized firms exit en masse; policy also drives increased R&D investment and accelerated shift toward innovation. By end-2024, cumulative passed/deemed-passed products reached 2,998, with contract manufacturing share rising from 12% (2020) to 33% (2024).

initiatives.zh: 国办发〔2016〕8号：明确评价对象（289目录基药口服固体制剂）、时限（基药2018年底前）、参比制剂原则、激励措施（优先采购、医保支持、技改资金）
initiatives.en: State Council Circular [2016] No. 8: defined scope (289 essential drug oral solids), deadline (end-2018 for essential drugs), reference formulation principles, incentives (priority procurement, reimbursement support, technical upgrade funding)

initiatives.zh: 2018年12月调整：取消统一时限要求，改为'时间服从质量'原则，同品种首家通过后其他企业3年内完成
initiatives.en: December 2018 adjustment: removed uniform deadline, adopted quality-over-speed principle; other companies must complete within 3 years after the first firm passes for the same molecule

initiatives.zh: 2020年5月注射剂扩展：NMPA公告正式启动化学药品注射剂仿制药一致性评价，已上市全部注射剂仿制药须按新要求补充申请
initiatives.en: May 2020 injection extension: NMPA announcement formally launched consistency evaluation for marketed generic chemical injections, requiring supplementary applications for all products

initiatives.zh: 2019年起集采绑定：国家集采（带量采购）要求参与品种须通过一致性评价，过评成为集采准入硬门槛，历批集采覆盖品种均已扩展至过评品种
initiatives.en: VBP linkage from 2019: national volume-based procurement requires passing consistency evaluation as a hard entry barrier; all successive VBP rounds expanded to cover passed products

initiatives.zh: 2025年延伸：国务院办公厅意见将一致性评价逐步向滴眼剂、贴剂、喷雾剂等复杂剂型拓展，覆盖范围持续扩大
initiatives.en: 2025 expansion: State Council opinion extended consistency evaluation to complex dosage forms including eye drops, patches, and sprays, further broadening scope

timeline.zh: 国办发〔2016〕8号发布，正式启动仿制药一致性评价工作
timeline.en: State Council Circular [2016] No. 8 issued, formally launching generic drug consistency evaluation

timeline.zh: 国务院官网公开发布全文，各省开始转发执行
timeline.en: Full text publicly released on State Council website; provinces begin implementation

timeline.zh: 国家药监局开始发布参比制剂目录（首批），为企业提供参照标准
timeline.en: NMPA begins issuing reference formulation catalogues (first batch), providing benchmarks for companies

timeline.zh: 调整289目录时限要求，取消统一截止日期，改为'时间服从质量'原则
timeline.en: Deadline for 289-list essential drugs adjusted; uniform cutoff removed, replaced by quality-first principle

timeline.zh: 第一批国家集采扩围正式与过评挂钩，集采常态化启动
timeline.en: First national VBP expansion formally linked to consistency evaluation passing; VBP institutionalized

timeline.zh: NMPA发布公告，将一致性评价扩展至注射剂品种
timeline.en: NMPA announcement extends consistency evaluation to generic chemical injections

timeline.zh: 累计过评（含视同过评）品种数突破2,998个；委托生产占比升至33%，行业集中度显著提升
timeline.en: Cumulative passed/deemed-passed products exceeded 2,998; contract manufacturing share reached 33%, demonstrating significant industry consolidation

timeline.zh: 国务院办公厅发布新意见，将一致性评价扩展至滴眼剂、贴剂、喷雾剂等复杂剂型
timeline.en: State Council opinion expands consistency evaluation scope to complex dosage forms including eye drops, patches, and sprays

affected_companies.note_zh: 在前七轮集采中35个仿制药品种中选22个、平均降幅74.5%，仿制药收入大幅缩水，但过评能力强推动公司加速转型创新药，研发占比升至近30%
affected_companies.note_en: 22 of 35 generic products selected in first seven VBP rounds with 74.5% average price cut, sharply compressing generics revenue, but strong GCE capabilities accelerated pivot to innovation with R&D ratio approaching 30%

affected_companies.note_zh: 过评受理号超50个，积极参与集采，但集采价格压力导致仿制药业务收入下滑，公司加速布局创新药以对冲影响
affected_companies.note_en: Over 50 accepted GCE applications; actively participates in VBP, but procurement price pressure compressed generic revenues, pushing accelerated innovation pipeline build-up

affected_companies.note_zh: 创新程度较高，集采后成长韧性较强，过评品种进入集采带动销量提升，仿制药与创新药双线推进
affected_companies.note_en: Higher innovation orientation demonstrated stronger growth resilience post-VBP; GCE-passed products captured VBP volumes, supporting dual-track generics and innovation strategy

affected_companies.note_zh: 2020年第二轮集采中当家品种阿卡波糖片丢标，直接暴露仿制药集采风险，加速向创新资产收购转型，2020-2024年与至少24家药企达成合作
affected_companies.note_en: Lost VBP bid for flagship acarbose tablets in 2020, directly exposing generic VBP risk; accelerated pivot to licensing-in innovation assets, partnering with at least 24 firms in 2020-2024

affected_companies.note_zh: 以自我治疗药物（OTC/中药）为主，受仿制药集采冲击较小，集采常态化后成长韧性突出，一致性评价对其核心业务影响有限
affected_companies.note_en: Core business centered on self-medication OTC/TCM is largely shielded from generic VBP; demonstrated strong growth resilience; GCE impact on core segments is limited

affected_companies.note_zh: 麻醉镇痛市场份额25.9%居首，积极推进麻醉药仿制药一致性评价，过评品种可进入集采带来量的增长，但集采价格降幅压缩利润空间
affected_companies.note_en: Leads anesthetic analgesic market with 25.9% share; actively advancing GCE for anesthetic generics; passed products gain VBP volume access but face significant price compression

affected_companies.note_zh: 集采常态化后出现一定业绩下滑，仿制药销售受价格压力明显，但作为大型医药流通+制造综合体，通过供应链整合部分对冲影响
affected_companies.note_en: Experienced revenue decline post-VBP institutionalization; generic sales face clear price pressure, partially offset by supply chain integration as a major pharma distribution and manufacturing conglomerate

affected_companies.note_zh: 集采后出现一定业绩下滑，仿制药品种集采中标降幅大，加速通过海外并购和创新药布局寻求增长替代
affected_companies.note_en: Experienced revenue decline post-VBP; generic products won VBP bids with significant price cuts; accelerated overseas M&A and innovation pipeline development to seek growth alternatives

policies.title_zh: 药品审评审批制度改革与中国加入ICH
policies.title_en: China Drug Review & Approval Reform and ICH Accession
policies.summary_zh: 国务院2015年发布44号文启动审评审批制度改革，2017年中办国办深化改革意见确立四条加速通道，同年中国加入ICH并于2018年首次进入管委会，推动创新药全球同步上市。
policies.summary_en: China's State Council launched drug review reform in 2015 (No.44), deepened in 2017 with breakthrough therapy/conditional approval/default clinical trial approval pathways; joined ICH in 2017 and was elected to its Management Committee in 2018, enabling global concurrent drug development.
policies.agency_zh: 国务院 / 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅 / 国家药品监督管理局
policies.agency_en: State Council / General Offices of CPC Central Committee and State Council / NMPA

detail.direction_zh: 系统性重构药品审评审批体系，建立与国际接轨的加速通道，推动中国从仿制药大国向创新药强国转型。
detail.direction_en: Systematically restructure the drug review and approval system, establish internationally aligned accelerated pathways, and drive China's transformation from a generic-drug producer to an innovative-drug powerhouse.
detail.focus_zh: 优先审评审批、突破性治疗药物、附条件批准、临床试验默示许可四条加速通道；接受境外多中心临床数据；ICH技术标准全面转化实施。
detail.focus_en: Four accelerated pathways: priority review, breakthrough therapy designation, conditional approval, and default clinical trial approval; acceptance of overseas multi-center clinical data; full implementation of ICH technical standards.
detail.implications_zh: 打通创新药境内外同步研发通道，大幅缩短上市时间差，利好本土创新药企、CRO/CDMO平台及在华布局全球同步申报的跨国药企；消化积压存量审评的同时向创新倾斜，仿制药价值相对承压。
detail.implications_en: Opens pathways for concurrent domestic and global R&D; significantly reduces approval lag for innovative drugs; benefits domestic innovators, CRO/CDMO platforms, and MNCs running global synchronous filings; tilts resources toward innovation while generic drug value faces relative pressure.

initiatives.zh: 国发〔2015〕44号：12项改革任务，提高审批标准、推进仿制药一致性评价、药品上市许可持有人制度试点、临床机构资质从认证改为备案
initiatives.en: State Council No.44 (2015): 12 reform tasks including raising approval standards, generic drug consistency evaluation, MAH pilot system, and shifting clinical institution qualification from certification to record-filing

initiatives.zh: 厅字〔2017〕42号：临床试验由明示许可改为默示许可（60个工作日内未否定即视为同意）；设立突破性治疗药物程序；建立附条件批准上市制度
initiatives.en: CPC/State Council [2017] No.42: Clinical trial default approval (silence within 60 working days = consent); breakthrough therapy designation program; conditional marketing approval system

initiatives.zh: 2017年6月中国正式加入ICH（第8个监管机构成员）；2018年首次当选ICH管委会成员；2021年、2024年连续连任
initiatives.en: June 2017: China officially joins ICH as the 8th regulatory member; 2018: first elected to ICH Management Committee; re-elected in 2021 and 2024

initiatives.zh: 接受境外多中心临床数据：符合ICH GCP要求的境外注册研究数据可直接用于中国NDA申报，推动全球同步研发（MRCT）
initiatives.en: Acceptance of overseas multi-center clinical trial data: data compliant with ICH GCP can be used directly for China NDA filings, enabling global concurrent development (MRCT)

initiatives.zh: 2020年国家药监局正式发布《突破性治疗药物审评工作程序（试行）》等配套文件，将四条加速通道制度化
initiatives.en: 2020: NMPA formally issues Breakthrough Therapy Designation Review Procedures (Trial) and related documents, institutionalizing the four accelerated pathways

initiatives.zh: 2025年1月深化改革：临床试验审评时限从60个工作日缩短至30个工作日；扩大数据保护范围，覆盖罕见病用药和儿童用药
initiatives.en: January 2025 deepening reform: clinical trial review timeline shortened from 60 to 30 working days; expanded data protection scope covering rare disease and pediatric drugs

initiatives.zh: ICH技术指南全面转化：截至2021年已转化实施46个ICH指导原则，涵盖E（有效性）和M（多学科）系列，中国专家参与69个ICH议题国际协调
initiatives.en: Full ICH guideline implementation: 46 ICH guidelines transposed by 2021, covering E (efficacy) and M (multidisciplinary) series; Chinese experts engaged in 69 ICH issue coordinations

timeline.zh: 国务院发布国发〔2015〕44号《关于改革药品医疗器械审评审批制度的意见》，12项任务启动改革
timeline.en: State Council issues No.44: 'Opinions on Reforming Drug and Medical Device Review and Approval System', launching 12 reform tasks

timeline.zh: 中国国家食品药品监督管理总局（CFDA）正式成为ICH第8个监管机构成员
timeline.en: China's CFDA officially becomes the 8th regulatory authority member of ICH

timeline.zh: 中办国办联合印发厅字〔2017〕42号，确立突破性治疗、附条件批准、临床默示许可、优先审评四大加速通道
timeline.en: General Offices of CPC CC and State Council jointly issue [2017] No.42, establishing four accelerated pathways including breakthrough therapy designation and conditional approval

timeline.zh: 国家药监局（NMPA）首次当选ICH管委会成员，中国正式参与国际药品监管规则制定
timeline.en: NMPA first elected to ICH Management Committee; China officially participates in shaping international drug regulatory standards

timeline.zh: NMPA正式发布《突破性治疗药物审评工作程序（试行）》等三项文件，四条加速通道全面制度化落地
timeline.en: NMPA formally issues three implementing documents for accelerated pathways, fully institutionalizing breakthrough therapy, conditional approval, priority review, and special approval

timeline.zh: 国家药监局在日本福冈ICH全体会议上第三次当选管委会成员，中国国际药监话语权持续强化
timeline.en: NMPA elected to ICH Management Committee for the third time at the Fukuoka plenary, further cementing China's voice in global drug regulation

timeline.zh: 国务院深化监管改革：临床试验审评时限压缩至30个工作日，数据保护扩围，创新资源进一步倾斜
timeline.en: State Council deepens reform: clinical trial review shortened to 30 working days, data protection expanded, further tilt toward innovation

timeline.zh: 2025年全年批准创新药76个（国产化学药占比80%+、生物制品91%+），创历史新高，为改革十年成效的最直接体现
timeline.en: 76 innovative drugs approved in 2025 (domestic share: 80%+ for small molecules, 91%+ for biologics), a record high and testament to decade of reform

affected_companies.note_zh: 泽布替尼等多款产品经优先审评快速获批，全球同步研发模式受益于境外临床数据互认，加速中美双报，成为改革红利最大受益者之一
affected_companies.note_en: Zanubrutinib and other products gained rapid approval via priority review; global concurrent development model benefited from overseas data acceptance, enabling simultaneous China-US filings

affected_companies.note_zh: License-in模式高度依赖境外临床数据互认政策，审评改革大幅压缩引进品种与全球上市的时间差，多款产品通过优先审评或附条件批准在华快速获批
affected_companies.note_en: License-in model directly relies on overseas clinical data acceptance; reform drastically cut the approval lag for in-licensed products; multiple products approved via priority review or conditional approval

affected_companies.note_zh: 国内创新药管线（PD-1阿帕替尼等）借助优先审评通道加速上市；ICH标准接轨推动国际化注册，加速出海布局
affected_companies.note_en: Domestic innovative pipeline (PD-1, apatinib, etc.) accelerated to market via priority review; ICH alignment drives international registration and overseas expansion

affected_companies.note_zh: 信迪利单抗等PD-1产品经优先审评和附条件批准通道快速获批，突破性治疗制度助力肿瘤创新药研发节奏与跨国药企拉近
affected_companies.note_en: Sintilimab and other PD-1 products approved rapidly via priority review and conditional approval; breakthrough therapy program helps domestic biotech match MNC development pace

affected_companies.note_zh: 临床试验默示许可缩短启动时限、ICH GCP标准统一、全球同步研发需求激增，直接拉动CRO/CDMO外包量增长
affected_companies.note_en: Default clinical trial approval shortens trial start-up time; ICH GCP harmonization and surge in global concurrent development directly drive CRO/CDMO outsourcing volume growth

affected_companies.note_zh: 审评改革推动境内外多中心临床试验（MRCT）需求快速增长，作为国内头部CRO泰格医药同步承接本土及跨国药企全球注册研究订单
affected_companies.note_en: Reform drives rapid growth in MRCT demand; as a leading domestic CRO, Tigermed captures both domestic and MNC global registration study orders

affected_companies.note_zh: 率先推进中国研发全球同步，境外临床数据互认政策使在华200+在研项目可与全球开发100%同步，加速新适应症在华上市
affected_companies.note_en: A pioneer in China-global R&D synchronization; overseas data acceptance enables 100% global sync across 200+ China pipeline projects, accelerating new indication approvals

affected_companies.note_zh: 多款肿瘤创新药经优先审评通道在华获批，全球同步申报战略受益于境外数据互认，中国市场增量显著
affected_companies.note_en: Multiple oncology innovative drugs approved in China via priority review; global synchronous filing strategy benefits from overseas data acceptance, driving significant China revenue growth

affected_companies.note_zh: 埃克替尼等EGFR靶向药借助优先审评制度加速上市，审评改革整体提升国内靶向创新药竞争力和注册效率
affected_companies.note_en: Icotinib and other EGFR-targeted drugs accelerated to market via priority review; reform overall improves domestic targeted innovative drug competitiveness and registration efficiency
